content.short: LearnerShape provides AI-driven verifiable credentials and skill authentication solutions on Cardano.
content.description: LearnerShape is an innovative technology project on Cardano that leverages artificial intelligence to provide verifiable credentials (VCs) and skill authentication. Through their SkillsGraph initiative, the platform uses the Atala PRISM framework to record professional certifications and academic achievements immutably on the blockchain. By providing a tamper-proof way to verify skills, LearnerShape helps individuals and organizations navigate the modern job market with greater trust. The project is a leading example of how blockchain can revolutionize identity and education globally.
